Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

When you're stressed, you get so nervous and agitated that your state of mind affects your body - blood works its way to your skin, obvious in your sleeping environs and staining your clothes.

Trigger/Effect: You begin play each night an additional point down in your Blood Pool. In addition, the blood is quite obvious and you're often nervous and twitchy.
